blockingFindings.authority: Contract/report require owned-group stop for wall/resource/operational/outer-signal faults; this is containment mechanics, not a product law.
blockingFindings.smallestRepair: Make stop reentrant (for example threading.RLock) or avoid acquiring that lock from the signal handler; preserve the same stop scope and limits.
blockingFindings.witness: After handlers are installed, main enters stop and owns non-reentrant stop_lock; SIGINT/SIGTERM arrives before killpg; handler reenters stop on that same thread and blocks acquiring its own lock; main cannot finish stop and timer blocks on that lock too.
